items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: chasing people like Kid Horry, because I was a pretty serious jazz record collector... soak up the music... hear like Horry

ctx.x: We were talking earlier, and I'd like to get you placed in your age and everything. When's your birthday?

Oh, it comes in September every year, whether I want it to or not. Born in 1926. My college years, grew up in California. My college years started 1943. I had to go in the Navy in 45, 46, then got back to college and started chasing people like Kid Horry, because I was a pretty serious jazz record collector by that time, and spent a lot of time trying to soak up the music. I had taken cornet lessons when I was nine years old. Never was very distinguished. The school music teacher would always put me in the…
Who else did you hear live other than Horry's band? Who else did you hear? Who else did you hear?
